text:
zoe: Heads up — I brought a mason jar to the kitchen labeled "Quiet Applause". Put a sticky note with a tiny compliment in it when you see someone do a thing you liked. :sparkles:
jamal: Love this. Is it weird if I put a doodle in there instead of a compliment? :grimacing:
zoe: Nope, doodles welcome. stickers too. no slam poetry though. :sweat_smile:
maya: Also adding "tiny victories" slips. e.g., "fixed prod alert before coffee" :trophy:
alex: Can we have a ceremonial opening? Ribbon cutting? :scissors:
lina: I vote for ritual kazoo. kazoo is non-negotiable.
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen utensils are shared resources. Please label any kazoo you bring with your initials.
jamal: @lina single kazoo or kazoo choir?
lina: Choir. we will haunt the next onboarding.
zoe: Bonus: whoever collects the most notes by end of quarter gets the Golden Paperclip (hidden in the drawer). :eyes:
maya: where did this golden paperclip come from? it's now a myth.
alex: It was forged in the fires of the broken printer. passed down by the Ancients.
zoe: First note submitted: "zoe — made the meeting start on time with the best agenda. thank you." :heart:
lina: Aww. quiet applause received. :clap:
ops-bot: Note: new tradition logged to #random-rituals archive. :white_check_mark:
jamal: adding "jamal — fed the office plant during drought week" :seedling:
zoe: Great. put a doodle next to it.
